description: Get one LinkedIn/X article by id, plus a paste kit: title, subtitle, bodyHtml, bodyMarkdown (with [Image N] markers), cover and inline image URLs (+ alt/caption), teaser post, and the editor URL. There is no publishing API — present the kit to the user to paste into the LinkedIn/X editor, then call update_social_article with `publishedUrl` once it is live. If status is 'generating', poll get_job with the article's operationId; 'failed' carries an `error`.
name: get_social_article
